statement: Pinned Dolphin's Nunchuk emulator initializes a 16-byte calibration structure at extension register 0xA40020: accelerometer zero-g and one-g groups, X/Y stick max/min/center triplets, and two checksum bytes. Dolphin fills only 0x20-0x2F; its distinct 0x30-0x3F field is zeroed on reset. This conflicts with rnconrad's deliberate duplication of the same template at 0x20 and 0x30. Both are emulator behaviors, not retail calibration evidence.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Dolphin Extension.h:78-80, Extension.cpp:124-127, Nunchuk.cpp:107-143. Distinct zeroed 0x30 field; not a second initialized calibration block. WiiBrew Nunchuk subpage cross-reference: wii-gap-wiibrew-nunchuk-stick-center-calibration documents startup center acquisition but does not independently specify either 0x20 or 0x30 OEM block; Dolphin/rnconrad software conflict remains.
